Based on these inspirational comments, most research focused on the isolation, identification, and bioactivities of polysaccharides. In this review, a comprehensive summary is provided of the recent developments in the physical and chemical properties as well as biological activities of polysaccharides from a number of important natural sources, such as wheat bran, orange peel, barely, fungi, algae, lichen, etc. This review also focused on biomedical applications of polysaccharides. The contents presented in this review will be useful as a reference for future research as well as for the extraction and application of these bioactive polysaccharides as a therapeutic agent. **Keywords:**  bioactive polysaccharides; biomedical applications; extraction. Authors declare no conflict of interest. Anticancer polysaccharides from natural resources: A review of recent research.
